title: Intelligence Brief
headline: Earendil shipped Pi 1.0, the first stable release of its terminal coding-agent harness
subtitle: Earendil shipped Pi 1.0, the first stable release, Cloudflare open-sourced Clef and Clef-flash, NVIDIA/OpenShell fell to GitHub Trending #3 but

insights.text: Earendil shipped Pi 1.0, the first stable release of its terminal coding-agent harness -- 'a hardened, minimal, extensible agent harness you can make your own,' MIT-licensed, claiming hundreds of thousands of weekly users. The release adds native Codemode/MCP support, deferred tool loading, and a full-screen TUI default cutting codemode prompt tokens by roughly 40%. An experimental Pi Durable package ships alongside it for longer-running agents.

Cloudflare open-sourced Clef (27B) and Clef-flash (9B), non-autoregressive decision models on frozen Qwen backbones, reporting wins over OpenAI's Jev on median latency (38.8ms vs 524.1ms), BFCL accuracy (98.76% vs 95.75%), ToolRet ranking, and BANKING77 classification. Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, hosted on Workers AI, with a two-phase RL fine-tuning platform (hands-on now, self-serve later).

NVIDIA/OpenShell fell to GitHub Trending #3 (14,106 total, down from #1's 13,034) but its scraped daily-star velocity nearly doubled (+2,456 vs yesterday's +1,281) -- a split result that satisfies only half of this vault's own stated falsification test (rank drop AND velocity collapse), leaving the sandbox runtime's trajectory genuinely ambiguous rather than confirmed or refuted.

A browser-use co-founder's pull request trimmed the Anthropic-integration quickstart's system prompt for brevity; a reviewer caught that the cut removed explicit language instructing the model to ignore instructions embedded in webpage content -- a live near-miss of the exact prompt-injection failure class documented in prior University of Washington and Black Hat research on agentic browsers, caught by review before merge.

DietrichGebert/ponytail debuted at GitHub Trending #1 (+1,194/day, 150,760 total), a plugin that enforces a 'laziest senior dev' shortcut-ladder discipline across 20+ agent hosts, reporting -54% lines of code, -22% tokens, -20% cost, and -27% time with 100% safety preserved on its own benchmark. Its /ponytail-debt command collects deliberate shortcuts into a ledger -- a naming and mechanism match to this very research pipeline's own CLAUDE.md convention of tagging shortcuts as `// ponytail: <ceiling>, <upgrade path>`.

mattpocock/skills climbed to GitHub Trending #2 (+883/day, 274,067 total) from #9 yesterday (+876/day, 273,147 total) -- a rank improvement on essentially flat daily velocity, meaning relative rather than accelerating growth against yesterday's board.
